written_before: any v2 model was trained, exported or scored, and before the slang/Gen Z silver labels existed
label_provenance: silver-claude-clef; no human labels exist for English. All numbers are agreement with Claude+Clef labels, not ground truth.
candidate: v2 seed 1 only (one seed, last epoch, no seed picking, no checkpoint selection). Recipe = v1 recipe unchanged (experiments/gidi-en-student-v1/run.sh: init models/gidi-en-v1-init, 40 epochs, batch 8, encoder lr 5e-5, head lr 1e-3, warmup 0.1, wd 0.01).
changes_vs_v1: training data adds datasets/annotation-en-v1/silver-slang-train.jsonl (Clef 16-shot kNN teacher, pool = seed, new slang and Gen Z notes written by Gemini; complete, self-consistent notes only)
decode-time word-boundary snapping (gidi.inference.decode.snap_to_words: expand a predicted span to whole words, never shrink): scoring of the candidate is with snap ON
training_data: silver-train + labels-seed complete + silver-slang-train (consistent only). Never: test, dev, datasets/probe-en-slang, datasets/probe-en-genz, Vietnamese data.

eval_only_sets.slang_probe: datasets/probe-en-slang (complete notes, n = 357 for v1). Never trained on.
eval_only_sets.test: datasets/annotation-en-v1/splits/test.jsonl primary (consensus, n = 214) and secondary (all complete, n = 290).
eval_only_sets.genz_probe: datasets/probe-en-genz (~100 held-out Gen Z notes, Gemini+Clef consensus, Claude adjudicated). EXTRA: reported, not part of pass/fail.

success.existing_protocol: experiments/gidi-en-data/protocol.json (primary and secondary acceptance unchanged), evaluated with the same decode as the candidate
success.rule: all conditions must hold; PASS or FAIL is reported as is. No threshold, data, seed or decode change after seeing any v2 score.
